❓ Help / วิธีใช้ — draw · panels · cut · trim · shortcuts
Draw: click = set point · line follows the cursor · click again = next point · click the first point to close the shape. Near horizontal/vertical it locks red / green; hold Shift to keep the lock. Just type a number (metres, decimals ok) + Enter for the exact length. ▭ Wall W×H + Add = instant rectangular wall without clicking.
Panels: enter a panel code to drop panels (w × 2.9 m); hold & drag to auto-tile a row; Fill tiles the whole wall. Opening → type the door/window size & click to cut it out; covered panels become movable offcut pieces.
Move (Ctrl+M): tap to select, drag a box for multi-select, drag as a group, arrow keys nudge 1 cm (Shift = 10 cm). Del deletes, Ctrl+C/V copy/paste, Ctrl+H/Harvest cuts the selected overhang (panel stays 1.1, offcut = 1.2 — drag back in & harvest again). Cut = free cut anywhere (Shift = vertical width-cut). Trim = tap edges to mark finishing profiles (m + pcs in the stats).
View: mouse wheel / pinch = zoom · middle-mouse / two fingers = pan · ⊕ resets. Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo (work is autosaved). Save/Load = named sketches on this device · Copy = image + stats to clipboard · → Quote sends the panel count to a quotation. Esc exits a tool.
